AAD.caption: ID of Input
AAD.doc: The element which will listen for ENTER press. Needs to be a unique ID. Will break if more than one element has the same ID on the page.
AAD.name: inputID

AAE.caption: ID of Submit Button
AAE.doc: The element to be triggered when ENTER is pressed from the input.  Needs to be a unique ID. Will break if more than one element has the same ID on the page.
AAE.name: submitID

AAG.caption: Re-focus input after sending
AAG.doc: When this box is checked, the input will be reset and re-focused after [Enter] is typed. Do not use this option if you are manually resetting and focusing in your Bubble workflow.
AAG.name: Refocus

AAI.caption: Confirm you are retrieving the input value from this plugin's element's submittedText state, instead of from the input
AAI.doc: To avoid race conditions, DO NOT retrieve the value from the input directly. Instead, get the submittedText state off of the plugin element. This checkbox doesn't do anything, it's just there to help you understand how to use this plugin.
AAI.name: I am retrieving the input value from this plugin's element's submittedText state, instead of from the input

AAJ.caption: Submitted Text
AAJ.doc: The text that the user just submitted. Use this instead of the input's value in your workflow to avoid race conditions.
AAJ.name: submittedText
